Re-states the pacing contract into every live session it can reach: every
configured environment's own AI session (over that environment's MCP edge)
and every persisted orchestrator definition. Reports each target's outcome —
pushed, or skipped and why — rather than only reporting that it ran.

A CLI/MCP process has no channel into a desktop-held orchestrator's live PTY,
so every orchestrator is reported skipped as unreachable from this transport;
only the desktop's own automatic pass can push those. An environment with no
currently open MCP edge (nobody has it open in the desktop) reports skipped as
not alive, since there is no live session there to push.

Pass TENANT and ENVIRONMENT to whip one environment; omit both to whip every
configured environment plus every persisted orchestrator.

Usage:
  erun whip [TENANT] [ENVIRONMENT] [flags]

Examples:
  erun whip
  erun whip --tenant team --environment dev
  erun whip --dry-run

Flags:
      --dry-run              Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
      --environment string   Whip only this environment (requires --tenant)
  -h, --help                 help for whip
      --json                 Write JSON output
      --tenant string        Whip only this tenant's environment (requires --environment)

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.
